description: This Java interface defines a service for managing device credentials within the Eclipse Hono project, including methods for setting and retrieving credentials, with detailed documentation and external API references.

classes.name: CredentialsManagementService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage device credentials, including setting and getting credentials, with detailed API documentation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates or creates a set of credentials for a device, with parameters for tenant ID, device ID, credentials list, resource version, tracing span, and result handler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials registered for a specific device, with parameters for tenant ID, device ID, tracing span, and result handler.
